episode_summary: This episode of Keeping It Real features Austin Clarence discussing the implications of the Federal Reserve's leadership change, the benefits of DSCR loans for investors, and current mortgage rate trends. Listeners will gain insights into leveraging these strategies to better serve investor clients and navigate the current market landscape.
